correctness.rationale: Itô's formula yields the exact positive-semidefinite preserving covariance lift K'=AK+KA^T+2r²diag_i(DK_ii+HΣ_{j≠i}K_jj), with r=α/L, L=β+(s-1)c, δ=D+(s-1)H. Starting at K=I by permutation equivariance gives u' and v' exactly from 2r[[-β+rδ,-c(s-1)],[-c,-(β+(s-2)c)]]. Dominating xx^T≤||x||²I and using trace Φ_t(I)=Σ E||X(t;e_i)||² proves the u exponent controls every deterministic initial vector. The larger eigenvalue is r[-β-B+rδ+sqrt((B-β+rδ)^2+4c²(s-1))]. Its determinant sign reduces precisely to ((β-c)L²-αδB)/L. c=0 decouples consistently. Independently checked the moment-lift algebra and the two-species witness (s=2,α=1,β=2,c=1,D=0,H=4): symmetric rates (-8±2sqrt(13))/9<0 and antisymmetric rate -20/9; the printed source threshold would exclude it. This is linear Itô mean-square stability only.
